subject: Re: BrightBridge cohort — stipend bucketing & post-trial grace request
body:
From: Lisa Hart <lisa@brightbridgelabs.org>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Khan <samir.k@brightbridgelabs.org>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: BrightBridge cohort — stipend bucketing & post-trial grace request

Hi Nikhil,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're excited about Redwood as a core inference option for our accelerator cohort. A few asks from our program ops team that I wanted to get in writing so you have context: 

- Can the $10k cohort stipend be split into per-team buckets (up to 8 teams per cohort) rather than a single pool? Ops wants each startup to have a dedicated monthly allocation for the first 90 days.
- If a team doesn't fully use its allocation in month 1, can unused credits roll forward to month 2 (up to 30% of the monthly allocation)?
- After the free 90-day trial ends, BrightBridge wants a 30-day "grace" window for teams to move to paid plans before credits are deactivated so we can transition billing without blocking dev work.

We know these are slightly different than your standard startup stipend terms — appreciate any flexibility. If there are audit/logging or invoicing requirements we should be aware of, flag them.

Best,
Lisa
Program Director | BrightBridge Labs
(attachment: sample_ops_flow.pdf)

-----
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Hart <lisa@brightbridgelabs.org>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BrightBridge cohort — stipend bucketing & post-trial grace request

Lisa — thanks for the clear list. We can outline two approaches that keep compliance simple while meeting your ops needs:

Option A — Per-team buckets (preferred for ops):
- Create 8 named sub-allocations under the cohort account, each with its own credit balance and simple metadata tag (team-name).
- Unused credits may roll forward month-to-month up to a 30% cap on per-month carryover (matches your ask).
- System will emit per-bucket usage logs daily; we can expose an aggregated CSV for your ops team (or a Drive link).
- Post-trial: 30-day grace window is supported, but finance requires a signed SOW addendum that calls out the grace window and how credits reconcile after the window (we propose final reconciliation within 14 days of the end of grace period).

Option B — Single pool with soft reservations:
- Easier from a billing perspective: one pool with reservation tokens assigned to teams. Unused reserved tokens expire monthly and roll into the pool (no per-team carryover).
- Simpler SOW, but less granular visibility for you.

I copied Lauren (billing/finance) and Ben (program partnerships) to confirm feasibility and preferred contract language.

Next steps: if you prefer Option A, we'll prepare a short SOW addendum and an example reconciliation template. If Option B, we can move faster on contract and provisioning.

—Nikhil
Nikhil Sharma
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

-----
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Lisa Hart <lisa@brightbridgelabs.org>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 08:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BrightBridge cohort — stipend bucketing & post-trial grace request

Nikhil / Ben / Lisa — quick finance note:

- Option A is acceptable but we need the per-bucket metadata to be immutable once the cohort is live (team-name may be updated but the bucket id, initial allocation, and carryover cap must be recorded to prevent disputes).
- Carryover cap of 30% is doable, but we require that any roll-forward be visible in the monthly reconciliation export; we cannot allow manual ad-hoc reversals without a signed change order.
- For the 30-day grace window: finance will require a clause that clarifies what happens to unused credits at the end of the grace period (proposal: leftover credits revert to BrightBridge and will not be refundable). We can offer a one-time transitional discount code for teams that commit to a paid plan within the grace window (15% off first 3 months) — that must be in the SOW.
- Attachments: I'll draft a short SOW addendum and the reconciliation template.

Lauren Bishop
Sr. Revenue Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
(attachment: credit_reconciliation_template.xlsx)

-----
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Hart <lisa@brightbridgelabs.org>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BrightBridge cohort — stipend bucketing & post-trial grace request

Lisa — thanks for pushing this through ops. We discussed internally and we're happy to approve Option A with the following specifics so we can ship quickly:

- Implementation: We'll provision 8 per-team buckets in the cohort account, each pre-loaded with equal monthly allocations totaling the $10k stipend across 3 months.
- Carryover: Unused credits may carry over month-to-month up to 30% of that team's monthly allocation; carryover beyond that is forfeited back to BrightBridge at cohort end.
- Grace window: 30 days post-90-day trial. Unused credits after the grace window are reclaimed by BrightBridge (non-refundable). Redwood will offer a one-time 15% transitional discount code for teams that convert to paid within the window.
- Audit & exports: Daily per-bucket usage logs; monthly CSV export to the Drive link Lauren will create.
- Contract: We're attaching the short SOW addendum and the reconciliation template. If that looks good, Nikhil will route the SOW to BrightBridge legal for signature and we'll spin up the buckets.

We'll send the attached SOW and template now. Give us a day to generate provisioned buckets after the signed SOW.

Best,
Ben Carter
Partnerships Lead | Redwood Inference
(attachments: BBL_Cohort_Stipend_SOW_v1.pdf, credit_reconciliation_template.xlsx)

-----
From: Lisa Hart <lisa@brightbridgelabs.org>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 17:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BrightBridge cohort — stipend bucketing & post-trial grace request

Ben / Nikhil / Lauren — this looks great and thanks for the quick turnaround. A couple small clarifications before signature: 

1) Can the per-bucket names be edited by BrightBridge ops if a team changes cohort slots? We want flexibility for human ops changes but understand the immutability constraint Lauren mentioned — if we can edit the display name (not the bucket id or allocation) that works.
2) For the reconciliation CSV, will the file include the tokenized model usage (tokens in/out) or just monetary spend per bucket? Ops would like token-level detail for their engineering reports.

If you confirm both, we'll sign the addendum and route to legal. Appreciate the 15% code offer — will be helpful for conversions.

Warmly,
Lisa
Program Director | BrightBridge Labs

(attachment: sample_ops_flow.pdf)

-----
On Thu, 29 Apr 2027 at 17:30:00 -07:00 Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com> wrote:

Lisa — yes to both: display names editable by BrightBridge ops; bucket ids and allocations immutable. Reconciliation CSV will include token-level usage, per-model breakdown, and dollar spend columns. We'll include an example column mapping in the Drive export.

I'll ask Nikhil to kick off SOW routing once you confirm.

—Ben
